adm_ask_broadcast: 📢 Send the broadcast text as one message.
adm_bc_started: 📢 Broadcast started, I'll send a report when it's done.
adm_ask_ban: Send the ID of the user to ban.
adm_ask_unban: Send the ID of the user to unban.
adm_no_such_user: No such user in the database.
adm_id_not_number: The ID must be a number. Try again or /cancel.
adm_ask_userinfo: Send a user ID to see their card.
adm_ask_model: Send the model ID (as shown in your provider's dashboard).
adm_prompt_menu: Choose the mode whose prompt you want to view or change. Every mode has two prompts: RU (for the Russian interface) and EN (for the English one). Changes apply to everyone immediately.
adm_prompt_note_default: The bot adds the user's personal instructions (/myprompt), saved messages and the web-search hint to this prompt by itself.
adm_prompt_note_mode: The bot adds the user's saved messages and the web-search hint (if the mode allows it) to the mode prompt by itself.
adm_ask_prompt: Send a new system prompt for the “{title}” mode ({code}), up to {max} characters. It will replace the current one for all users.
adm_prompt_reset: ♻️ The mode prompts were reset to the defaults.
adm_prompt_too_long: Too long: {n} characters, the maximum is {max}. Shorten it or /cancel.
adm_memory: The bot stores both the user's messages and the AI's answers — all of it goes to the model with every request. The bigger the memory, the more tokens are spent and the longer an answer may take.
📏 Size limit: {chars} characters of history per request. If the dialog is longer, the oldest messages are not sent to the model (but stay in memory until pushed out).
In the database now: {total} messages from {users} users, 📌 saved: {pins}.
Allowed range: {min} to {max}. When you decrease it, old messages are deleted for everyone right away.
adm_ask_memory: Send how many messages to remember ({min} to {max}). A question and an answer count as two messages.
adm_ask_hist_chars: Send the history size limit in characters (1000 or more). The smaller it is, the faster the answers, but the fewer messages the model really sees. Now: {n}.
adm_memory_bad_number: A whole number from {min} to {max} is needed. Try again or /cancel.
adm_hist_bad_number: A whole number of 1000 or more is needed. Try again or /cancel.
adm_ref: Invite bonus: {state} — both the friend and the inviter get it, for good.
Maximum friends with a bonus per person: {mx} (the invited friend always gets the bonus).
The bonus is added to the daily limit (⏱ Limits) and granted after the friend's first answer. New values only affect future invitations — bonuses already granted don't change.
Opened the links: {refs}, started using the bot: {paid}
adm_ask_ref_bonus: Send how many requests per day to give for an invitation (0 turns the bonus off). Now: {n}.
adm_ask_ref_max: Send the maximum number of friends the inviter gets a bonus for (0 — only the friend gets a bonus). Now: {n}.
adm_bad_number_range: A whole number from 0 to {top} is needed. Try again or /cancel.
adm_web: Status: {state} (a user can turn it off in their settings)
adm_web_tip: 💡 No key is set, so the free search is used with no guarantees. For stability, get a free Tavily key and add it to the TAVILY_API_KEY variable.
adm_sources: 🎁 Invitations via friends' links: {refs}, started using the bot: {refs_paid}
How to track sources. For every place where you publish the bot, give your own link with a tag:
The tag is Latin letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters (for example vc_post, tg1). Only new users who pressed “Start” are counted.
adm_src_line: • {name} — total {n}, wrote to the bot {act}, new in 7 days: {d7}
adm_ask_limit: Send the number of requests {what} (0 — unlimited).
adm_limit_bad: A whole number is needed (0 — unlimited). Try again or /cancel.
adm_speed: ⏱ Timeout without data: {timeout} s, total: {total} s
🚫 Models that rejected the reasoning parameter: {bad}
Reasoning level — the lower, the faster the answer. “Speed test” measures the time to the first word at different levels and shows whether the provider accepts the parameter.
adm_eff_pick: Lower — faster answers but less “thinking” on hard tasks.
“Default” — the parameter is not sent, the provider's own setting applies.
adm_fb_pick: Used when the main one didn't answer (timeout or an error before the first word).
adm_st_ok: to the first word: {ttft} s, total {total} s{extra}
adm_st_done: Done. Pick the best option in the “Speed” section.
adm_maint_on: 🔧 Maintenance is on: regular users see the maintenance message.
